about: Shared test vectors of the EFI rules: every implementation (efi.sh: release/test-efi-vectors.sh; IntelXe-EFI.ps1: windows/test/Test-EfiVectors.ps1; the WinUI app) must give these plans and results. Language-neutral; the format is described in docs/design/DESIGN-efi-rules.md section 5.

vectors.name: bootlog-already-on

vectors.name: bootlog-off-after-on
